briefs.title: Create a personalized digest/audio brief from the top validation and decision-making concerns

quality_gate: Every recommendation links to at least one evidence or demand signal ID.
The output states what changed or why this matters now.
The output declares the next measurable outcome.
The digest preserves the source concern IDs behind every segment.
The output can be read aloud without restructuring.
